summary: Ticketplus Ltd., a Chilean foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, providing unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, along with an operating and financial review. The filing is intended to incorporate these statements into its existing Form S-8 registration statement. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is disclosed; the filing is purely a routine financial reporting update. No deal terms, advisors, or recommendations are present. The event is routine financial reporting, not a special situation.
